## Professional Background & Expertise
Tapendu Pal is an experienced software engineer and automation specialist with over 2.5 years of industry experience at Cognizant (Joined June 6, 2024 as Program Analyst on US-based client projects). He specializes in designing, prototyping, and deploying enterprise-grade test automation frameworks and applied AI solutions.

## Key Projects & Deployments
1. **AI-Powered Facebook Auto-Reply Extension [Live & Deployed]**
   - An intelligent Chrome Extension integrated with backend AI APIs.
   - Automatically monitors and reads comments on Facebook posts, understands context, tone, and user intent, and generates personalized, human-like automated responses with seamless execution.

2. **AI Test Script Recorder & Code Generator [Live & Deployed]**
   - A smart browser extension that records user browser interactions in real-time.
   - Synthesizes robust XPaths and CSS locators, leveraging backend AI to instantly generate ready-to-run automation test scripts in Playwright, Selenium, Java, Python, and JavaScript.

3. **Autonomous Self-Healing QA Agent Pipeline [In Active Development]**
   - An advanced agentic AI system designed for self-healing UI locators, continuous automated regression testing, and multi-modal defect root-cause analysis.
